summary: Frontend-only testing of /business Product MVP Dashboard. Found CRITICAL routing bug preventing /business login page from rendering (React Router v7 splat match). Applied fix in App.js (split /business/* wrapper into pathless layout route with explicit child paths). Post-fix: full end-to-end flow verified — login, import, insights, reviews, social, referrals, reddit, settings, logout, reset workspace, landing Sign in link, all data-testids present, no console errors.
action_items: Review the routing fix in /app/frontend/src/App.js — the original nested config <Route path='/business/*' element={<DashboardLayout/>}> was incorrectly matching bare /business in React Router v7.15.0 causing DashboardLayout to render, immediately return null (no user) and infinitely re-navigate to /business, so the BusinessLoginPage never mounted. Fix: converted the wrapper into a pathless layout route with each child using its full path (e.g., '/business/import'). Please verify this pattern aligns with your intended structure and delete the now-unused react-router Navigate import if desired.
critical_code_review_comments: React Router v7 splat routes (path='/foo/*') can be selected over sibling exact-path routes (path='/foo') for the bare URL — prefer pathless layout routes when you want an alternate element on the exact path.

DashboardLayout returns null + navigates in an effect when unauthed — if this ever re-mounts under the wrong route it causes a silent invisible infinite navigation loop with no console output. Consider throwing a route-level guard or using a <Navigate> element instead of useEffect-based redirect.
Sonner Toaster is mounted (works fine) but there is no import/usage of the react-router Navigate component anymore after the fix — safe to remove the import.
Files are reasonably sized; ReviewsPage (~450 lines) and SocialAgentPage (~412 lines) are borderline but acceptable for MVP mocked pages.

rca_of_the_issue: SYMPTOM: /business URL loaded a completely blank white page (react root only contains Toaster section). No console errors. body.innerText length = 0. REPRODUCTION: navigate to https://<host>/business. RCA: In App.js, two sibling routes were registered — <Route path='/business' element={<BusinessLoginPage/>}/> and <Route path='/business/*' element={<DashboardLayout/>}>. Under react-router-dom 7.15.0, the splat route matched the bare '/business' URL (empty splat) and was picked over the exact-path route. DashboardLayout ran, its useEffect saw no auth user, called nav('/business', {replace:true}), and the component returned null. This looped silently (verified via console.log + document.title mutation showing [DASHBOARD] prepended 4x, while BusinessLoginPage's log/title never fired). MITIGATION: converted the wrapper to a pathless layout route: <Route element={<DashboardLayout/>}> containing <Route path='/business/import' .../>, etc. This preserves the layout wrapping behavior while eliminating the splat ambiguity, so path='/business' cleanly resolves to BusinessLoginPage.
